body: Similar to https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaAtmos.jl/pull/4843, https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaLand.jl/pull/1884, and https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCoupler.jl/pull/2132, I used [LintApp.jl](https://github.com/julia-vscode/LintApp.jl) with unused_function_argument = "off" and ask a LLM to fix the majority of the issues found. I reviewed each edit before committing them.
title: Fix lint issues
